1. Using the belt tensioner, slacken the tension of the single drive belt.

2. Remove the belt from the pullies.

Do not allow oil or solvents to come into contact with the belt, as these could affect the flexibility of the rubber, resulting in reduced grip.

Also check that there are no cracks or cuts on the belt, otherwise it will have to be replaced.
